main_text.p: ceat; tàm incondito garritu & dissolu-to furore omni modestiâ posthabitâ Sacras Musas interstrepere; calumniis tàm impudenter proscindere Inclytæ Academiæ Lugduno-Batavæ Professorem Medicæ Praxeos Primarium, Virum experientissimum, indefessâ diligentia de studiosa Juventute optimè merentem. Ego certè putavi tantillum me debere honori Facultatis Medicæ atque existimationi Collegæ conjunctissimi, ut hominis audaciæ obviam irem, demonstraturus jejunum hunc Medicum in Philosophia, Medicina, Hippocrate itidem & bonis auctoribus planè hospitem, Sylvium non modò nusquam refutasse, sed ne verosimile quidem argumentum illi objecisse: & quod seriò notatum velim, ipsum Sylvio nunquam contradixisse, quin Hippocrati pariter aliisque Veteribus turpiter contradixerit; illudque præstitisse ut veritatis amantes dubitaturi sint, sitne

page.notes: Page number "4" and running head "Fl. Schuyl" at the top. The word "sitne" at lower right is a line-end continuation; it is kept in the text and also listed as catchword. Some letters are blurred in the scan (e.g. "Medicum", "Hippocrate" and "ut" in the final line), but read as printed.
